tools.name: image-compress-convert
tools.description: Compress, convert and resize images. Supported image input/output formats are .jpg | .png | .webp | .jpeg

imagePath.description: The absolute path to the image to compress and/or convert. It's important that the path is aboslute. The path should contain the filename and the extension.

outputPath.description: The absolute path to the output image. It's important that the path is aboslute. The output path should contain the file name and the extension.

convert.description: If present, convert the image to the specified format. If not present, the image will not be converted.

quality.description: If present, set the compression quality (1-100), if not present, the image will not be compressed.

alphaQuality.description: This value will only be used if "quality" is set. If present, set the alpha quality (1-100), if not present, the alpha channel will not be compressed.

adaptiveFiltering.description: This value will only be used if "quality" is set. If present, set the adaptive filtering, if not present, the adaptive filtering will not be used.

width.description: If present, set the width of the image. If not present, the width will not be set.

height.description: If present, set the height of the image. If not present, the height will not be set.

fit.description: If present, set the fit of the image. If not present, the fit will not be set. OPTIONS: "cover": Crop to cover both provided dimensions (the default). "contain": Embed within both provided dimensions. "fill": Ignore the aspect ratio of the input and stretch to both provided dimensions. "inside": Preserving aspect ratio, resize the image to be as large as possible while ensuring its dimensions are less than or equal to both those specified. "outside": Preserving aspect ratio, resize the image to be as small as possible while ensuring its dimensions are greater than or equal to both those specified. Some of these values are based on the object-fit CSS property.

annotations.title: Compress, convert and resize an image.
